spec.description: One alert by its identifier, including the polygon it was drawn for when it has one. The identifiers come from `alerts.get_active_alerts`.

id.description: Alert identifier, such as `urn:oid:2.49.0.1.840.0.<hash>.001.1`. `alerts.get_active_alerts` returns it as `properties.id`.

response.description: The alert, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in. No envelope is declared here: unlike the forecast endpoints, this geometry is real data -- the area the alert was drawn for.

notes: The identifier contains colons and periods, which the client percent-encodes into the path.
